blocks.text: While he opted not to meddle in the feud between his children Lotlot de Leon and Ian de Leon, Christopher de Leon said he is certain the two will eventually mend their strained relationship. The veteran actor spoke up for the first time about the siblings’ conflict during an interview on Ogie Diaz’s YouTube vlog on Friday, Sept. 18. “Nakausap ko na silang dalawa, hiwalay, not the same day.
